description: This device replaces conventional battery connections with a connector port that can plug into a UPS.  Any device modified with this can be used without a battery as long as you have a charged UPS with you.
This device extends the conventional battery connections with a connector port that can plug into a UPS.  Any device modified with this can toggle whether to charge its battery from UPS power.
A battery compartment mod that allows using vehicle and storage batteries in regular tools, up to the size of a large storage battery, as unwieldy as that may be.
